# Dries Bielen

> Portfolio of Dries Bielen, a full stack developer based in Belgium, building websites, mobile apps, backend systems, and tools for businesses and community organizations.

Dries has a background in Application Development at PXL University College in Hasselt, Belgium. His project experience includes React, Vue, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java Spring Boot, .NET, Flutter, MySQL, Firebase, Appwrite, and Docker.

This portfolio includes individual and team projects. The project pages describe his role, technologies, features, and development experience for each project.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://driesbielen.be/): Profile, skills, technology stack, and project overview.
- [About](https://driesbielen.be/#about): Background and education.
- [Contact](https://driesbielen.be/#contact): Contact details and professional profiles.

## Projects

- [Streetmasters](https://driesbielen.be/project/streetmasters): Website for a car cleaning business in Houthalen-Helchteren, with services, pricing, and contact information.
- [RBGH (Red Bull Gaming Hub)](https://driesbielen.be/project/rbgh-red-bull-gaming-hub): Volunteer management app with shift scheduling, a Java backend, Firebase, and Discord integrations.
- [OpenInzichten](https://driesbielen.be/project/openinzichten): Community platform for people with invisible illnesses in Flanders, built with Java Spring Boot, Vue, Docker, and MySQL.
- [JH Sungarden](https://driesbielen.be/project/jh-sungarden): Youth center website presenting activities, programs, and events in Zonhoven, Belgium.
- [Joke Bylemans](https://driesbielen.be/project/joke-bylemans): Responsive media portfolio for a presenter, voice-over artist, and content creator, built with Vue, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Vite.
- [MVC Peer](https://driesbielen.be/project/mvc-peer): Volleyball club website with VolleyScores API integration for standings and match information; Dries's first website.
- [ShiftManager](https://driesbielen.be/project/shiftmanager): Shift scheduling and contribution points tracking for clubs and organizations.
- [DRS-Voting](https://driesbielen.be/project/drs-voting): Real-time audience voting app for events, built with Flutter, Appwrite, and Docker.
- [DRS Stream](https://driesbielen.be/project/drs-stream): Remote livestream infrastructure connecting a Raspberry Pi to a homelab using Docker, Tailscale, MediaMTX, and Node.js.
- [MosselSystem](https://driesbielen.be/project/mosselsystem): Management system for order processing, kitchen workflows, cash register operations, and hall management, originally built for Chiro Wilduraantjes.
- [PingPingDing](https://driesbielen.be/project/pingpingding): School payment balance app built with Flutter, .NET, Docker, and API integration.
- [Barbiepoppen Expo](https://driesbielen.be/project/barbiepoppen-expo): Exhibition website presenting the history and cultural impact of Barbie dolls.
- [Connect 4](https://driesbielen.be/project/connect-4): Team school project combining a .NET backend with a responsive frontend for a two-player Connect 4 game.
